subject: Onsite wrap: distribution of notes + action ownership

From: Emma Price <emma.price@orbisfinancial.com>
To: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Cc: tom.alvarez@orbisfinancial.com
Date: Thu, 14 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Thank you + request for consolidated notes and owner list

Hi Lauren / Marissa,

Thanks again for hosting the executive workshop yesterday — the facilitation was excellent and the team walked away with a lot of clarity. A couple of asks from our side as we close the loop:

1) Can you send the consolidated meeting notes and the final slide deck?
2) We'd like a one‑page action owner list we can distribute to our execs (owner, short description, due date).
3) Any follow-up materials (security checklist, data handling notes) should be included or linked.

I'm attaching the version of the materials we used on our end in case that helps. If possible we'd like the notes and owner list by EOD tomorrow so we can brief our CFO ahead of next week's steering call.

Best,
Emma Price
Head of Product Strategy
Orbis Financial

Attachments:
- Orbis_Exec_Workshop_Materials.pdf (PDF, 1.2 MB)

- Marissa will review and produce the final slide pack with our suggested next milestones and the recommended rollout timeline.
- Vivek will pull the security checklist and data handling one‑pager (for your procurement/security ops).

Proposed due times: notes + owner list by 6pm PT today; full pack with attachments and Drive folder link by 11am PT tomorrow. Does that work for you?

Sharing a working Drive folder now for comments: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3Cefg-WorkshopNotes

If you want different owners or to escalate any item to your GTM lead, flag it in the comments and we'll update the owner column.

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
